title: OpenTitan top_earlgrey (chip top, upstream)
_note: The Earlgrey CHIP TOP, which the opentitan-ip family excludes because its scope is the IP library.  Same pin, roots, include path and flags as opentitan-ip (f49474bc, the commit caliptra-ss fetches); those roots name only top_earlgrey's own generated directories, so another top's `top_pkg` / `top_racl_pkg` (darjeeling TL_AUW=28 vs earlgrey 23) never enters the closure.  top_earlgrey is the row, not chip_earlgrey_asic: the chip wrapper needs the analog model and pad ring.  Its 89 ports are plain input / output of package struct types, so no flat shim is needed.  read_uhdm reads it in 5.3 GB.  Beyond opentitan-ip's roots it needs the Ibex core (vendor/lowrisc_ibex/rtl -- without it `ibex_pkg` is undefined and the import aborts on cross-module wire references), vendor/pulp_common_cells/rtl, and top_earlgrey/ip/: the top-generated crossbars (xbar_main, xbar_peri and their tl_*_pkg) and sensor_ctrl / ast_pkg; the closure takes only what top_earlgrey references, so the analog `ast` model itself is never pulled in.  hw/dv/sv/dv_utils is on the include path for Ibex's `dv_fcov_macros.svh` (compiled to nothing under SYNTHESIS).  read_timeout: the read takes ~15-17 min, above ext_flow's 900 s floor.
